data.name: Infrastructure Governance Analyst, Work Bank's Transport Global Practice
data.role: Infrastructure Governance Analyst, Work Bank's Transport Global Practice
data.informationNeed: I am an Infrastructure Governance Analyst with the World Bank’s Transport Global Practice, where I study how institutions, regulatory frameworks, and investment strategies shape the safety and performance of transportation systems in developing economies. My work involves analyzing accident reports, operational data, and policy documents to identify systemic risks in rail, road, and port networks, and to understand how governance structures—such as oversight bodies, funding models, and safety regulations—affect infrastructure reliability. I collaborate with engineers, economists, and government counterparts to translate these findings into policy recommendations and technical assistance for modernization and safety reform.

data.name: Crowd Dynamics and Public Safety Researcher,  Delft University of Technology, Faculty of Civil Engineering
data.role: Crowd Dynamics and Public Safety Researcher,  Delft University of Technology, Faculty of Civil Engineering
data.informationNeed: I study the behavior and movement of large crowds in public spaces, with a focus on safety, infrastructure design, and emergency planning. My work involves analyzing how people move through streets, public squares, and transportation hubs during large gatherings. Using observational data, simulation models, and behavioral research, I help identify conditions that can lead to congestion or safety risks in dense crowds. My research supports the design of safer public events and more effective crowd management strategies.

data.name: Investigative Journalist, Dawn News
data.informationNeed: I am a senior investigative journalist at one of Pakistan's most widely read English-language newspapers, specializing in the intersection of judicial proceedings, military influence, and civilian governance. My work involves cultivating sources across the legal community, political parties, and civil society to build long-form narratives that go beyond the official record. I frequently file requests under Pakistan's Access to Information laws, attend court hearings, and analyze public statements from the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) alongside those from political spokespeople to identify inconsistencies.

data.name: Gender and Society Researcher, University of Karachi, Department of Sociology
data.role: Gender and Society Researcher, University of Karachi, Department of Sociology
data.informationNeed: I am a sociologist studying gender relations, family structures, and cultural practices in South Asia. My research examines how social norms, economic pressures, and local power dynamics shape marriage practices and gender roles. I conduct fieldwork, analyze case studies, and collaborate with community organizations to understand how traditions evolve over time. My goal is to provide evidence-based insights that help policymakers and educators address harmful practices while respecting cultural complexity.
